Tokens whose readings span more than one lexeme. Genuine homonymy is real and stays, but a duplicated identity raises this while making the analyzer worse, and one shipped on this branch before the ceiling existed. New homonymy now needs a stated justification. v0.12 wave 1 (+18): the Alypy §73 reflexive derivation inherits its host's readings, so a host that already spans two lexemes yields a two-lexeme reflexive reading; no identity was added.
